item.title: CORTIS Tells NYC to Put Their Phones Down at First U.S. Solo Concert: The 7 Best Moments
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the show! Today, we're talking about the rising stars of CORTIS, a quintet that's been making waves in the music scene. In just under a year, they've achieved some incredible milestones, including a No. 3 debut on the Billboard 200 and a spot on Billboard's 21 Under 21. They've also performed at Lollapalooza, collaborated with big names like Juicy J and Teezo Touchdown, and even had a soundtrack single for the animated film GOAT.
[Music transitions to a lively beat]
Host: Recently, CORTIS kicked off their Put Your Phone Down Tour in the US, with their first-ever solo concert in New York City at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden. The show was a huge success, with the group performing nearly all of their discography in the first half, complete with choreography and stunning visuals. The second half of the show took a more relaxed approach, with the focus on the group's energy and performance.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of CORTIS' music]
Host: The New York concert was just one of seven sold-out shows across North America, and it's clear that CORTIS is on the rise. With their comfort and charisma on stage, they won over the crowd and left a lasting impression. From their high-energy performance to their shoutouts to New York's NBA Finals win, CORTIS proved that they're a force to be reckoned with.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to this episode! If you're a fan of CORTIS or just discovering them, be sure to check out their music and catch them on tour. They're definitely a group to watch in the coming years. [Outro music continues to play until the end]
